##### Project general facts

Nourelle by Meraas is a refined architectural composition set within the prestigious Madinat Jumeirah Living community, where contemporary design meets natural harmony. Sculptural forms, clean lines, and softly layered greenery define the façade, creating a seamless dialogue between urban elegance and tranquil surroundings. The residences, ranging from one- to four-bedroom apartments, are thoughtfully designed with open layouts, expansive terraces, and floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light while framing captivating views of the city skyline.

The lifestyle at Nourelle is shaped by a curated collection of amenities designed for both relaxation and connection. Residents can unwind by shimmering infinity pools, recharge in a state-of-the-art fitness center, or find balance in the serene rooftop yoga spaces overlooking the city. Landscaped gardens, sky terraces, and pocket parks create peaceful retreats, while family-friendly features such as children’s play areas, daycare facilities, and community spaces foster a vibrant and welcoming environment. Elegant lobbies, residents’ lounges, and a signature skybridge further enhance the sense of exclusivity and community.

Interiors at Nourelle reflect understated luxury through modern finishing and high-quality materials, creating spaces that are both elegant and functional. Equipped kitchens are seamlessly integrated into the living areas, designed for everyday convenience and refined living. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing owners the freedom to personalize their homes while enjoying a sophisticated foundation of design, comfort, and timeless appeal.

##### Location description and benefits

Madinat Jumeirah Living is an exclusive residential community that captures the charm of traditional Arabian architecture blended seamlessly with modern luxury. Nestled in the heart of Dubai and just moments from the iconic Burj Al Arab, it offers residents a peaceful sanctuary surrounded by lush landscaping and meandering walkways. With its timeless design and refined ambiance, Madinat Jumeirah Living stands as one of Dubai’s most desirable addresses for those seeking tranquility and prestige.

Life in Madinat Jumeirah Living is enhanced by a wealth of lifestyle amenities thoughtfully designed to promote relaxation and well-being. Residents can enjoy shaded courtyards, fitness centers, children’s play areas, and serene community gardens that encourage a healthy and active lifestyle. Every element within the community reflects meticulous attention to detail, creating a setting where comfort, beauty, and convenience come together harmoniously.

Beyond its elegant residences and amenities, Madinat Jumeirah Living offers an exceptional location that connects residents to Dubai’s most prestigious landmarks. Within walking distance lies Souk Madinat Jumeirah, with its waterfront dining, boutique shopping, and charming canals. The area also provides easy access to Jumeirah Beach, major business hubs, and top international schools, making it ideal for families and professionals alike.
